name: Chlorine Concentration from Dosing Rate (Parametric)
description: Residual chlorine concentration is parametrically computed from the dosing rate: C_Cl = R_dose × η_mix / Q_flow. Dosing rate uncertainty propagates through this affine formula to concentration uncertainty.

elements.name: Sodium Hypochlorite Dosing Rate
elements.description: Dosing pump volumetric flow rate of sodium hypochlorite solution.

uncertainty.source: SWaT dataset: reduced dosing rate for lower chlorine demand periods

elements.name: Maximum Residual Chlorine
elements.description: WHO drinking water guideline: maximum residual chlorine

consistency_relations.expression: C_Cl = R_dose * eta_mix * rho / Q_flow <= C_max
consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(R) = F·R + f; F = η_mix×ρ/Q_flow ≈ 0.0496 (mg/L)/(mL/min), f=0
consistency_relations.upr_description: Parametric UPR: chlorine concentration CZ is affine image of dosing rate CZ through C=R×η/Q formula.
